Economy · India

US-India trade deal nearing completion, envoy says

A U.S. envoy stated that a trade agreement between the U.S. and India is in its final stages, with both nations aiming to finalize an interim deal by July. The envoy cited the personal relationship between the U.S. President and the Indian Prime Minister as a driving factor. However, India also faces concerns regarding European Union metal scrap curbs that could impact supply and costs ahead of the pact.
